# S1.7 — Land the effect & transaction model + the Stage-1 durability slice (§5a.2/§5a.3⁰ᵃ, R-2.2.2/R-2.2.3⁰ᵃ)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5a.2 (R-2.2.2) · §5a.3 `R-2.2.3⁰ᵃ` ·
ADR-0030/0031/0032 · ADR-0100 (I-4) · ADR-0130 (e)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/011_S1.7__effect-model-durability-slice.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.2.2**, **R-2.2.3⁰ᵃ**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.6` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 · **Live stage:**
offline-only

## Summary
Lands the §5a.2 effect & transaction model and the §5a.3 Stage-1 durability slice.
The twelve-class `action.effect.*` family is enforced as a typed state machine at
`append` — `intended → authorized|refused → prepared → deferred? → committed →
observed|unknown → probed → … → compensated|reverted|abandoned` — folded into a
rebuildable `RunState.effects` (live and replayed stores agree, CC1). Write-ahead
`committed` is the durable barrier: `action.tool.started` naming a
non-`read_only` effect in a pre-`committed` phase is refused `NotCommitted`, and
`CommitToken` binds `(effect_id, attempt_no, fencing_token, commit_event_id,
commit_seq)` at the helper seam. Fencing is inherited from the writer lease —
every post-`prepared` row carries `payload.fencing_token == current generation`.
The risk class `{reversibility, repeat_safety, scope}` is a danger-ordered lattice
(`hh-ontology::risk`); `project_risk` maps declared `EffectAttributes` onto it and
absent/unknown data projects to `UNKNOWN = irreversible + non_idempotent +
external`; effective risk only rises. The idempotency key
`H(run_id, effect_id, canonical(args), capability_version)` is stable across
attempts and restarts. **`not_applied` is attempt-terminal** — effect-terminal
only when the class forecloses retry (invariant 4; the compensable
"probe → `not_applied` ⇒ retry same key" row is reachable as
`committed{attempt_no + 1}` on the same `effect_id`; ADR-0238 §1).
`probed{applied|not_applied}` IS the `observed` transition (I-4: a late report
after `unknown` is never a second `observed`).

The durability slice: `checkpoint` as a `project` view (materializable,
`view_hash`-stable), `Store::restore` executing the normative recovery table —
takeover by generation fencing, every unresolved effect (`committed` without
terminal, non-terminal `observed`, already-`unknown`) fenced
`unknown{worker_lost}` under the new generation, open model calls failed
worker-lost, exactly one `lifecycle.run.resumed`, every action ledgered — and
`retry_due(now)` recomputed purely from durable `control.retry.*` rows with
`skipped{scope_closed}` for terminated scopes.

**Closes DF-S1.6-1** — `BudgetTree.open_effects` is now `effect_id → RiskClass`;
`exhaust` refuses `EffectsInFlight` only while an unresolved **non-`read_only`**
effect exists (`partial`/`undeterminable`/retryable-`not_applied` stay
unresolved; missing risk = `UNKNOWN`, still blocking).

## What changed
- **`crates/hh-ontology/src/risk.rs`** (new) — `RiskReversibility`,
  `RepeatSafety` (moved here from `hh-hir`, CC1), `RiskScope`, `RiskClass`,
  danger ordering + `max_by_danger`, `UNKNOWN`/`READ_ONLY` consts, JSON codecs.
- **`crates/hh-hir/src/risk.rs`** (new) — `project_risk(&EffectAttributes)`;
  `kinds.rs` drops its local `RepeatSafety` (re-export); `lib.rs` wires the module.
- **`crates/hh-ledger/src/effect.rs`** (new) — `EffectPhase`/`ObservedOutcome`/
  `ProbeVerdict`/`EffectFold`; `fold_event` (lenient) + `validate_event`
  (strict): phase gates, payload requirements, `attempt_no` sequencing, fencing,
  escalation refs on `abandoned`, dual-form `compensated`/`reverted` (in-scope vs
  `original_effect_id` marker), raise-only risk, derived `idempotency_key`,
  `CommitToken`, `commit_effect`/`validate_commit_token`, `scope_close_fires`
  (the one fold-conditional close predicate), `effect_fold`/`effects_in_state`.
- **`crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs`** — effect family + `control.retry.*` +
  `control.timeout.fired` rows; conditional `Effect` closers.
- **`crates/hh-ledger/src/{store,errors,lib,views,recovery}.rs`** —
  `RunState.effects`; `apply_scope_marks`/`check_scopes` fold-aware;
  I-1 `tool.started` gate; `Store::{checkpoint, restore, retry_due,
  commit_effect, validate_commit_token, effect_fold}`; `ViewKind::EffectLedger` +
  checkpoint view; recovery scratch/plan types; `BadEffectTransition`/
  `NotCommitted`/`Fenced` error arms.
- **`crates/hh-budget/`** — `open_effects: BTreeMap<String, RiskClass>` +
  `probe_verdicts`; the invariant-4 retryable rule; risk-aware E1 in
  `Account::exhaust`.
- **Tests** — `crates/hh-ledger/tests/effect.rs` (11), `hh-budget/tests/account.rs`
  additions, `hh-ontology` risk unit tests.
- **Build memory** — ADR-0238 (+ index), `DEFERRALS.md` DF-S1.6-1 → DONE,
  `docs/build/runs/S1.7.md`, this PR body.

## Design decisions
- `not_applied` terminality split (attempt vs effect) and the fold-conditional
  scope closer — ADR-0238 §1/§3.
- `probed{applied|not_applied}` lands `Observed` directly (no second row — I-4,
  CC1) — ADR-0238 §2.
- Restore fences *every* unresolved effect `unknown`, including non-terminal
  `observed` — ADR-0238 §4.
- Missing risk ⇒ `UNKNOWN` (most dangerous) everywhere — ADR-0238 §5.
- Typed E1 `read_only` exemption (DF-S1.6-1 closure) — ADR-0238 §6.
